{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Lab
| Image = Event-Lab.png
}}
{{E|Lab}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Search}} {{TS|positive||Find some Potions!}}
* Opens a rewards menu with three ({{Asc|15|two}}) random [[Potions]]. These can be skipped.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><i>
You find yourself in a room filled with racks of test tubes, beakers, flasks, forceps, pinch clamps, stirring rods, tongs, goggles funnels, pipets, cylinders, condensers, and even a rare spiral tube of glass. <br>

Why do you know the names of all these tools? It doesn't matter, you take a look around.
</i></blockquote>
